class.name: AbilityData
class.brief_description: A configuration resource that defines the static properties, costs, cooldowns, and tag requirements of a gameplay ability.
class.description: [AbilityData] is a data resource used to configure and define individual skills or spells before they are instantiated. It acts as a template, holding configuration parameters like resource [member cost], [member cooldown] timers, associated [EffectData] elements, and gameplay tags that dictate when and how the ability can be cast.

members.member: [Optional]. The [GameplayAbility] script containing the runtime execution logic (such as targeting, animations, and behavior) for this resource. If assigned, it uses a script template with virtual methods available for overriding.
The [GameplayAbility] cannot be activated if the owner has any of these [GameplayTag]s.
The required [GameplayTag]s that the executing entity must possess to successfully activate this [GameplayAbility].
Other [GameplayAbility]s that have these [GameplayTag]s in their Ability Tags are blocked from activating while this [GameplayAbility] is active.
By default 0, the duration in seconds that the entity must wait before this ability can be cast again.
By default 0, the resource value (ex. Mana, Stamina, or Health) required and consumed upon successfully committing the ability. It needs an existing attribute on the owner entity to deplete from.
StringName of the name of the attribute that contains the resource of the cost. (Ex. Mana, Stamina, etc.).
The array of [EffectData] resources (buffs, debuffs, or instant modifications) applied to targets when this ability executes.
